title: Vast footer
description: A black frame (16px on phones, 40px on desktop) holding two flat panels with 8px between them: a warm-grey sign-up panel (title left, a white email field with a dark 'Sign up' button right, a small consent note under it) and a white panel split by a vertical hairline: contact details, a flag slot and the wordmark with legal links on the left; two columns of links under mono headings plus social icons and the copyright on the right. On phones everything stacks into one column.
notes: the black frame is the theme's chart-5; the panels are card (sign-up) and popover (links)
the flag is an image slot (about 59×31); empty shows a placeholder
the sign-up form has no handler: add an `action` on your side or wrap the block
